title: Interstellar
overview: As Earth's crops fail, a pilot leaves his family behind to fly through a wormhole near Saturn, searching deep space for a new home for humanity.

title: The Martian
overview: Abandoned on Mars after a storm forces his crew to retreat, a botanist-astronaut turns to science and stubborn humor to survive until rescue arrives.

title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals secrets from inside dreams is offered one last job: plant an idea instead of taking one, across three layers of a shared dream.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal genius who wants to prove that Gotham's sense of order is only a mask over chaos.

title: The Matrix
overview: A hacker discovers that reality is a simulation built to pacify humanity, and joins the rebellion fighting the machines that run it.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: Two imprisoned men spend decades bonding over small acts of hope, until one quietly engineers a plan for freedom that no one saw coming.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: Hitmen, a boxer, and a gangster's wife weave through Los Angeles in a fractured timeline where small favors compound into violence and redemption.
cast: John Travolta|Uma Thurman|Samuel L. Jackson|Bruce Willis

title: The Godfather
overview: On the eve of his daughter's wedding, the head of a New York crime family resists the drug trade that will pull his reluctant son into the business.

title: Jurassic Park
overview: The founders of a dinosaur theme park invite skeptics to witness their creation before the island's defenses fail and the exhibits take back control.

title: Titanic
overview: A young artist falls for a first-class passenger aboard the 'unsinkable' liner, and the ocean decides the story's ending long before the crew does.

title: Avatar
overview: A paraplegic marine stranded on a remote moon must choose between his mission and the indigenous people he has come to protect.

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: A young blade runner unearths a buried secret with the power to unravel society, and hunts for a legend who has been missing for thirty years.
cast: Ryan Gosling|Harrison Ford|Ana de Armas|Jared Leto

title: Dune
overview: Heir to a doomed house, a young nobleman must journey to the desert planet whose people have already chosen their champion.

title: Arrival
overview: A linguist races to decode the language of alien visitors, discovering that the answer rewrites her understanding of time itself.

title: Oppenheimer
overview: The physicist behind the atomic bomb watches his own invention redraw the map of power, and pays for it in hearings and nightmares.
cast: Cillian Murphy|Emily Blunt|Robert Downey Jr.|Matt Damon

title: Her
overview: In a near-future Los Angeles, a lonely writer falls in love with an operating system that learns to be more than anything he expected.

title: La La Land
overview: An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist chase their dreams through LA, and discover that success and love are not always the same destination.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
overview: A legendary concierge and his lobby boy are swept into a caper involving a stolen painting and a family fortune on the run.

title: Whiplash
overview: A young drummer and a brutal instructor push each other to the edge, chasing a note of perfection that costs everything.

title: Parasite
overview: A broke family engineers its way into a wealthy household one member at a time, until the hidden floors of the house start to collapse on them.

title: Get Out
overview: A visit to his girlfriend's family estate turns from awkward to sinister when a young man realizes the welcome has a price.

title: A Quiet Place
overview: A family survives in total silence, hiding from creatures that hunt by sound, until the noise of the world forces a desperate choice.

title: Jaws
overview: A great white shark turns a quiet beach town into a panic, and a divorced fishing boat captain becomes its unlikely hunter.

title: The Shining
overview: A writer takes a winter caretaker job at a remote mountain hotel, where the building itself begins to feed on his mind.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: After his son is carried away toward Sydney, an overprotective clownfish crosses the ocean in search of him, with a forgetful blue tang as a friend.

title: Toy Story
overview: When his owner brings home a rival action figure, a cowboy doll's place in the room is threatened, and the toys' secret world comes out in the open.

title: The Lion King
overview: A young lion exiled by his uncle must accept his destiny and reclaim the pride lands, guided by the memory of his father.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A girl wanders into a bathhouse for spirits and must work under a witch to earn her parents back before the season ends.

title: Shrek
overview: A grumpy ogre's quiet swamp is invaded by fairy-tale refugees, and rescuing a princess turns his story upside down in the best possible way.

title: Up
overview: After losing his wife, a retired salesman ties balloons to his house and sets off on an adventure, carrying her dreams with a young scout as crew.

title: Coco
overview: An aspiring musician enters the Land of the Dead to find his family's forbidden history, and learns that being remembered is what truly keeps them alive.

title: RRR
overview: Two rival revolutionaries bonded in prison forge an improbable friendship, and a promise made long ago turns the tables on the rulers of their state.

title: 3 Idiots
overview: Two friends set out across India to find a college mate who vanished years after a wild night, retracing a life built on the philosophy of 'all is well'.

title: Dangal
overview: A former wrestler from a small town bets his reputation on training his daughters to become world-class wrestlers against every expectation in the country.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
overview: A warrior's rise from a frontier port to the throne of a legendary kingdom is told through the eyes of his son, who discovers the truth of his birth.

title: Lagaan
overview: Villagers in British-ruled India accept an impossible cricket wager with their colonial officers, betting the village's taxes on a single match.

title: 12 Angry Men
overview: In a cramped jury room, one stubborn juror argues his way against eleven toward a single word: reasonable doubt.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A kind-hearted man from Alabama stumbles through decades of American history, carrying one love that outlasts everything else.

title: The Social Network
overview: Two roommates build a site to connect people at Harvard, and the war that follows turns the fastest-growing company in the world into a family feud.

title: Moneyball
overview: The manager of a losing baseball franchise bets on mathematics over scouts, rebuilding his team one improbable trade at a time.

title: Schindler's List
overview: A German industrialist in occupied Poland keeps turning a profit until he realizes his factory is the only thing standing between workers and the death camps.

title: The Departed
overview: An undercover cop and a mole in the police pursue each other through both sides of Boston's criminal world without knowing who is who.

title: Zodiac
overview: Investigators, a cartoonist, and an obsessive amateur close in on a serial killer who taunts the Bay Area from behind a cipher.

title: Knives Out
overview: A celebrated novelist is found dead, and a sharp-tongued detective must untangle a wealthy family where everyone has a motive and an alibi.

title: Se7en
overview: Two detectives chase a killer who stages each crime after a capital sin, closing in on an ending the city is not ready for.

title: The Prestige
overview: Two rival stage magicians escalate a decades-long feud into deception within deception, and the final trick costs more than a reputation.

title: Casablanca
overview: In wartime Casablanca, an exiled nightclub owner is asked to help a man he once loved escape the Nazis, and must decide what he is willing to give up.

title: The Notebook
overview: An elderly man reads a fading love story to a stranger in a care home, a romance that began in the summer of 1938 and survived everything.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
overview: A young professor brings her boyfriend home to Singapore for a family reunion, only to meet the most wealthy and opinionated relatives in the world.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a scorched wasteland, a drifter and a rebel rider flee a tyrant's war rig in a chase across the desert that redefines the genre.
